column1: # Mobile CI guard manifest, run by scripts/ci/run_guards.sh in the `Guards` job.
# One guard per line: <name>TAB<flags>TAB<command>. Flags are `-`, or a
# comma-separated set of `native` (run only when native platform config
# changed) and `advisory` (never blocks; findings become warning annotations).
# Commands run through `bash -c` from mobile/. A command must not contain a tab.
# The driver runs guards in parallel and replays their output in this order, so
# the heaviest guards sit first: a Dart-AST detector costs ~8s of VM start plus
# package:analyzer JIT before it parses anything, and scheduling those before
# the sub-second grep guards keeps the last worker from being left alone with a
# 26s job. Keep the comments: every entry's rationale used to live on its
# workflow step, and this file is where a reader now finds it.
# Every scripts/check_*.sh either appears here or is named, with its reason, in
# test/tools/run_guards_test.dart — a guard that is in neither runs nowhere.
# Dart-AST detectors (heaviest first)
# Issue #3372. Freezes at ZERO the per-file count of Nostr identifiers
# shortened on the way into a log/debug sink, across mobile/lib,
# mobile/packages, mobile/test and mobile/integration_test. A truncated id
# looks correlatable and is not: `npub1abc...wxyz` cannot be grepped against
# relay logs or matched to a funnelcake row, and 8 hex of an event id is 32
# bits. UI shortening is NOT counted (display sink), and secrets are redacted
# whole rather than shortened — see the script header. AGENTS.md -> Nostr And
# Async Rules.
🔑 Verify no Nostr ID is shortened into a log (full-identifier ratchet)
🔐 Verify no profile publish reaches the ungated read provider (#6423)
🪵 Verify no raw logging in production code
# Issues #8314 / #6985. The account-switch sweep named its keys by copied
# string literal for nine months: eleven listed keys rotted into no-ops when
# their owning service was renamed or deleted, and fourteen live keys were
# never listed, two of them a real cross-account leak. The sweep now references
# the constants its services own, so a RENAME is a compile error. This freezes
# the other direction, which the compiler cannot see: a NEW key nobody
# classifies. Declare it in the sweep, or in a `deviceScopedPrefsKeys` list
# beside the constant — never here. Baseline entries are a worklist, not
# exemptions.
🧹 Verify every stored preference key is classified (#8314)
# Per-file CEILING over mobile/test, mobile/integration_test and
# mobile/packages/*/test, from a Dart AST rather than a regex: the regex missed
# a skip: whose reason dart format wrapped onto the next line, could not see
# @Skip, and needed one file excluded by name. Skip-debt epic: #4337 (WS-1) ->
# #4836. Fails closed if the baseline can't load.
🧪 Verify skipped-test count does not increase (skip-ceiling ratchet)
# Frozen at ZERO: a test whose every assertion is trivially satisfied
# (expect(true, isTrue)), or a *_test.dart declaring no test at all. #3340
# removed all 93 sites, so any hit is a regression. A test with no assertion is
# deliberately not counted -- imported helpers and third-party verifiers assert
# in ways one file cannot see. #3340.
🧪 Verify no test can pass unconditionally (placeholder ratchet)
# Frozen at ZERO: a test whose only assertion compares a re-read of state with
# an earlier read of it that was never pinned. Both operands come from the
# state under test, so with the method inert the test compares null with null
# (or 0 with 0) and stays green -- #8617 proved one by mutation. The
# placeholder ratchet above cannot see it: nothing here is a literal. Pin the
# baseline (expect(first, isNotNull)) before the act. #8617.
🧪 Verify no 'unchanged' assertion goes unpinned (state-tautology ratchet)
# Issue #3615: a flat test file gives the runner nothing to nest, so failures
# print as an undifferentiated wall and a file cannot be run a slice at a time.
# Freezes the per-file count of test/testWidgets/blocTest/patrolTest
# declarations outside any group() so it can only shrink. Group by method name
# (repositories/services/clients), event name (blocs/cubits), or
# renders/interactions/navigation (widgets).
🧱 Verify no test declaration sits outside a group (test-structure ratchet)
# Issue #8399, follow-up to #8170 / #7324. A stub in a shared setUp is
# invisible at every call site that inherits it, so a class of bug can go
# unobservable across a whole file -- #7324 shipped exactly that way. The shape
# also accretes silently: dm_repository_test.dart's block went from 6 stubs to
# 21 across 13 PRs, none of which looked wrong alone. Freezes the per-file
# count of stubs registered in a file-level or outermost-group setUp that
# descendant groups inherit, for files carrying 10 or more. Fix by declaring
# the stub in the groups that depend on it.
🧷 Verify shared-setUp stubs do not accrete (inherited-stub ratchet)
# Issue #3613. Freezes the per-file count of MaterialApp / CupertinoApp /
# WidgetsApp constructions under mobile/test that register no AppLocalizations
# delegate, so `context.l10n` under a test app can only get safer. Without a
# delegate that read is `Localizations.of<AppLocalizations>(...)!` on a null
# and throws "Null check operator used on a null value" — silently, only once a
# widget under test happens to reach it. Prefer testMaterialApp(...) from
# test/helpers/test_provider_overrides.dart.
🌍 Verify delegate-less MaterialApp count does not increase (l10n ratchet)
# Issue #7370, prevention follow-up to the #7293 Crashlytics aggregates fixed
# in #7356. Freezes the per-file count of bloc/cubit emit()/add() calls that
# can run after close() with no isClosed guard, so the "Cannot emit/add … after
# calling close" crash class can only shrink. Fix with emitIfOpen / addIfOpen
# from lib/blocs/close_guard.dart.
🧨 Verify post-close emit/add count does not increase (close-guard ratchet)
# Issue #9266. Rebuilding a provider from its registered service callback
# reinstalls the listener and resets local version state. Publish a changed
# value instead; this AST-backed guard is zero-based.
🔁 Verify service listeners do not invalidate their own provider
# Issue #8457, epic #4339. A `Timer(...)` nobody holds whose callback
# completes a Completer somebody awaits is a wall-clock wait with no owner:
# dispose() cannot cancel it, so the awaiting code resumes into a torn-down
# owner. It is Future.delayed with the name filed off, and
# check_future_delayed_production_ceiling.sh greps that literal, so it cannot
# see this shape at all. Fix with AsyncScope from lib/utils/async_utils.dart.
⏱️ Verify no uncancellable timer-backed waits (frozen at zero)
# Reliability ceilings (epic #4336). Each fails closed if the base baseline
# cannot be loaded.
🧯 Verify empty-catch count does not increase (reliability ratchet)
# Issue #8066, successor to #3372. Freezes at ZERO the per-file count of
# pubkeys interpolated into a log/debug sink in one encoding across mobile/lib
# and mobile/packages. Hex greps against relay and backend rows; npub is the
# only form a person can paste into a client, and Zendesk bug reports are
# one-way, so the log has to carry both. Fix with pubkeyForLogs
# (packages/nostr_sdk/lib/nip19/pubkey_for_logs.dart), which takes either
# encoding and truncates neither. Counts, booleans and collections that merely
# mention a pubkey are NOT counted.
🪪 Verify pubkeys reach logs as npub plus hex (encoding ratchet)
# Issue #7901. Freezes app call sites that can render a public divine_ui
# control while relying on its English semantic-label fallback. The AST
# detector understands conditional controls and constructor/static-helper
# forms, so non-password fields and sheets without completion actions do not
# create noise.
🏷️ Verify Divine UI semantic labels stay localized (a11y ratchet)
# Issue #8681. Raw indeterminate Material indicators repeat forever even when
# the platform disables animations, which prevents XCUITest hierarchy queries
# from reaching quiescence.
🌀 Verify progress indicators honor reduced motion
# Issue #9317. Skeleton shimmer and repeating AnimationControllers are the
# other two perpetual-animation shapes. Neither is a Material indicator, so
# the guard above cannot see them, and both ran on convention alone until
# this froze them at zero.
🌀 Verify perpetual animations honor reduced motion
# Issue #3630. Freezes the set of app_en.arb keys that nothing under mobile/lib
# renders (lib only — a test cannot render a string, and a findsNothing
# assertion is evidence the key is DEAD). An orphaned key is translated into
# 21 locales and compiled into AppLocalizations, yet never rendered — usually
# while the string it was written for sits hardcoded in a widget, still broken
# for non-English users. Nothing else sees it: arb_consistency_test proves a
# key exists in every locale (an orphan passes in all 22), and `flutter
# analyze` cannot report an unused getter on a generated class. Baseline
# entries are a worklist, each carrying '# wire: <path>:<line>' or
# '# staged: <why>'.
🗑️ Verify every ARB key is actually rendered (l10n ratchet)
# Issue #3633. Freezes the set of app_en.arb keys that interpolate a count but
# have no ICU plural. A flat countable key still renders the number — it just
# stops inflecting the noun, so English ships "1 videos". Nothing else catches
# this: arb_consistency_test checks key and placeholder parity, and
# plural_arm_number_test (#7153) only fires on arms that already exist. Most
# baseline entries are permanent (units, percentages, ordinals, ratios) and
# must NEVER be pluralized — each carries a trailing '# reason'.
🔢 Verify countable ARB keys carry ICU plurals (l10n ratchet)
🧱 Verify untested-services count does not increase (floor ratchet)
# Issue #8934: runtime package dependencies must remain a directed acyclic
# graph; dev-only test-fixture edges are deliberately excluded.
🔄 Verify workspace package dependencies remain acyclic
🕸️ Verify focused service-suite dependency scopes
📊 Verify pinned product analytics contract
# Native platform config (only when mobile/android, ios or macos changed)
# Skipped when no native config changed. The guard's only inputs are
# mobile/android/**, mobile/ios/**, mobile/macos/** and its own script; if none
# of those moved, its verdict is identical to the one main already recorded.
# The xmllint it needs is installed by the workflow step before the driver
# runs, under the same gate.
🔒 Verify native transport security
🍏 Verify iOS shipping target versions
# The wrapper is tracked (#7201) so a fresh clone or worktree can run gradle
# tooling without a prior `flutter build`. That makes gradle-wrapper.jar the
# one third-party binary here that check_dependency_provenance.sh does not
# cover -- it reads pubspec sources only. Gated on `native` for the same reason
# as the two guards around it: the guard's only inputs are mobile/android/**
# and its own script.
🐘 Verify the tracked Gradle wrapper is the pinned artifact
# Shell and Python guards (sub-second to a few seconds each)
# Deliberately NOT gated on `native`. That filter covers mobile/ios/*,
# mobile/android/* and mobile/macos/* but NOT mobile/packages/*/ios/*, and a
# first-party plugin is exactly where this drift happened: divine_camera's
# manifest was authored in #890 with an empty NSPrivacyAccessedAPITypes, then
# #1783 added ProcessInfo.systemUptime six weeks later under a path the native
# filter does not watch. Gating here would reproduce the bug the guard exists
# to catch. The check is pure python3 with no package installs, so running it
# every time costs well under a second.
🔒 Verify iOS required-reason APIs are declared
📵 Verify LibProofMode network fields stay privacy-gated
🌐 Verify backend-host defaults stay on *.divine.video
🌐 Verify no untagged test mutates HttpOverrides.global
🧬 Verify no untagged test leaks a process-global singleton
🧯 Verify integration_test error-handler restores are exception-safe
🧾 Verify every E2E service suite is accounted for
# LIST ratchet vs origin/main (fails closed if the base baseline can't load).
# The runtime heal-and-blame tearDown (flutter_test_config.dart) is the primary
# guard; this freezes raw setMockMethodCallHandler installs of the five shared
# channels so new ones must go through overrideSharedChannel(...). #5738.
🔌 Verify no new raw shared-channel installs (heal-and-blame ratchet)
🐝 Verify production Hive opens use the observable seam
# Packages analogue of the shared-channel ratchet above. Each package runs its
# own very_good --optimization merged isolate and — unlike mobile/test — has no
# flutter_test_config.dart heal-and-blame harness, so an un-torn-down channel
# mock leaks across that package's suite. Freezes package *_test.dart entries
# that install a channel handler without nulling any back down; new ones must
# add a tearDown (or a skip tag). #5838.
📦 Verify no new package-test channel leaks (per-package merged-isolate ratchet)
🚧 Verify Riverpod boundary (@riverpod / StateProvider locations)
🚧 Verify ChangeNotifier boundary (sanctioned-allowlist ratchet)
# Compares the baseline against origin/main (fetched once at job start); the
# guard fails closed when the base baseline cannot be loaded.
🚧 Verify UI does not import services directly (layering ratchet)
# Mirror image of the guard above: providers/services/repositories/state must
# not import screens, widgets, or the router, and route providers must not
# import screens. Those upward edges drag the whole screen graph — and through
# it app_providers.dart — into non-UI code. Route locations come from the
# RoutePaths leaf instead. #7383 (wave #4506).
🚧 Verify lower layers do not import the UI (layer-direction ratchet)
⏳ Verify Future.delayed-in-tests count does not increase (ratchet)
# Production (mobile/lib) counterpart of the test-scoped ratchet above. Fails
# closed if the base baseline cannot be loaded. Epic: #4339 (PR-4).
⏳ Verify Future.delayed-in-production count does not increase (ratchet)
# #4743: lazy-static singletons cannot be replaced in a test without reaching
# into static state. The set drifts when nothing watches it — #3623 counted
# 13, #4743 counted 14, and only 5 were left by the time either was re-read.
🧱 Verify singleton services do not regrow (DI ratchet)
# Hard architecture guard for #4338: the broad 800-line file-size check remains
# advisory, but oversized service-layer god-files are frozen at their recorded
# ceilings until a shrink is relocked.
🧱 Verify service god-files do not grow (architecture ratchet)
# Freezes the legacy non-mirroring test/unit bucket per-file so it can only
# shrink. New tests must mirror lib/ (test/services/foo_test.dart), never
# test/unit/. Fails closed if the base baseline cannot load. Test-org epic:
🧱 Verify test/unit does not re-accrete (test-structure ratchet)
# Issues #3574 / #3575: optionless packages silently inherit the app's relaxed
# analyzer config; workflow-less packages get no CI.
🧱 Verify every package ships analysis options + a CI workflow (package CI floor)
# Issue #3338. A package with no `flutter: sdk: flutter` entry has
# `depend_on_referenced_packages` rejecting every package:flutter import in its
# lib/ and test/, which is what makes the repository layer boundary enforced
# rather than conventional. Freezes the set of packages that still declare one
# so re-opening a boundary is a reviewable baseline edit. Fails closed if the
# base baseline can't load.
🧱 Verify no package re-adds a runtime Flutter dependency (boundary ratchet)
# Issues #3655 / #3363 (AC3): freezes the set of dependencies resolved from
# outside pub.dev, and rejects a movable git ref unconditionally (a branch or
# tag can be repointed under the build).
🔗 Verify dependency provenance (git refs + overrides ratchet)
# Follow-up to #3575: each package workflow's min_coverage is locked in a
# baseline and may only RISE. VGV already fails when measured coverage drops
# below the floor; this stops the floor itself from being lowered. Fails
# closed if the base baseline cannot be loaded.
🧱 Verify per-package coverage floors do not decrease (coverage floor ratchet)
🧯 Verify service error-sentinel count does not increase (reliability ratchet)
🧯 Verify ARB {error}-interpolation count does not increase (reliability ratchet)
# BLOCKING by decision (review on #6978): a copy change that breaks the E2E
# suite is real breakage, so this fails the job like every sibling ratchet.
# Unrelated ARB edits that trip it are fixed by regenerating the baseline in
# the same PR (UPDATE_BASELINE=1). Copy drift rotted the Maestro suite silently
# between 2026-03 and 2026-08 (#6948): copy in lib/l10n/app_en.arb and the
# flows diverged with nothing failing. The guard binds every asserted literal
# to its ARB key.
🧭 Verify Maestro suite copy stays aligned (e2e drift guard)
# Keep this independent from copy drift so contributors see both failures in
# one CI run. macOS hides case errors the linux_x2 runner hard-fails on.
🧭 Verify Maestro flow references resolve (e2e drift guard)
# The 800-line file-size ceiling is advisory (team decision): it reports new
# oversized files and files that grew relative to main, but the script always
# exits 0 and never fails the job. The driver turns its `WARN
# [file_size_ceiling]` line into a GitHub warning annotation so the finding
# bubbles up to the PR. Oversized-file epic: #4339 (PR-1).
📏 Report oversized files (advisory — does not block CI)
# Freezes the deferred raw Material Icons.* residue (#4803) per-file so the
# migration can only shrink. origin/main provides the base ref for the
# anti-bypass check; fails closed if it cannot load the baseline.
🎨 Verify raw Icons.* count matches its frozen ceiling (DivineIcon ratchet)
# Design-system drift ceilings (#6145, epic #4339). Each freezes a per-file
# count of raw UI patterns under mobile/lib so new drift is intentional;
# existing debt is baselined, not fixed. Fails closed if the base baseline
# cannot be loaded. New UI must use the divine_ui / VineTheme sanctioned
# replacements — see the script headers.
🎨 Verify raw TextStyle( count matches its frozen ceiling (VineTheme ratchet)
🎨 Verify raw color count matches its frozen ceiling (VineTheme ratchet)
🎨 Verify direct Material-button count matches its frozen ceiling (DivineButton ratchet)
🎨 Verify raw dialog/bottom-sheet count matches its frozen ceiling (VineBottomSheet ratchet)
🎨 Verify no VineTheme.*Font( call omits its color (light-mode ratchet)
🔙 Verify raw back-button pop count does not increase (safePop ratchet)
# Issue #8916. Material and Cupertino ship as the material_ui and cupertino_ui
# pub packages now. `package:flutter/material.dart` still exists in Flutter
# 3.47.2, so a reintroduced import compiles, analyzes and tests clean until its
# ThemeData or MaterialLocalizations meets ours -- and the type error then
# surfaces in a file that does not contain the mistake. Nothing else here reads
# import URIs.
🎨 Verify no legacy Material/Cupertino imports (frozen at zero)
